walk.action: Alternating articulated two-step walk in place in the approved direction.

hurt.action: Brace, recoil with bent knees, recover, neutral.

death.action: Knees buckle, kneel, collapse, prone and remain down. Never scale low poses to standing height.

style: Exact approved white-haired rose mage identity and pixel art. Native imagegen row per action; no rotated idle substitutes.
